scenes: July eighth. Iran attacks three ships in Hormuz.
The US strikes more than eighty targets.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they hit eighty-five US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait.
Trump, at the NATO summit. "I think it's over. I don't want to deal with them any more."
Bitcoin fell about two and a half percent, to around sixty-two thousand.
July thirteenth. Trump says the blockade is coming back, with a toll on ships.
In two trading days, Brent crude jumps eleven percent.
August sixth, in the Oval Office. "I don't think they can go much longer."
By late August, the war is six months old.
It has cost the US more than thirty-seven and a half billion dollars.
Before the war, about one hundred thirty ships a day crossed Hormuz. On August twenty-sixth, twenty-four did.
He's "not in a hurry" to get Iran back to the table.
